dedupe_keys.name: electricity consumption and meteorological data from paraguay

description: Morales-Mareco and coauthors publish electricity-demand and weather data for Paraguay’s National Interconnected System. ANDE supplies the electricity records, measured in megawatts, and GDAS supplies temperature, humidity, pressure, precipitation and wind components. A holiday calendar is included. The processed series have hourly resolution from January 2008 through December 2022, with 131,481 records stated for each series. Mendeley Data hosts version 3 with free public access under CC BY 4.0. The time stamps use Paraguay local time, and the provider explicitly reports a missing midnight hour when daylight-saving time begins. File formats are not stated in the inspected registry metadata or rendered file list and were not inferred. No payload was downloaded. The paired series support demand forecasting and weather-sensitive electricity scenarios. They provide a Paraguay-specific complement to data-open-power-system-data; combining the collections would require explicit time-zone and variable harmonisation.
